Maya C: Noticed preview vs final delta ~33% for tenant 'neo-hq' at 03:41 UTC. Preview jumped, ledger flat.
Owen L: Any recent egress or LB changes?
Maya C: Ops did an emergency scale at 03:40 and rotated a few hosts. suspect NAT churn.
infra-bot: event: egress-scale pool=eu-west-1 action=rotate started_by=ops
Owen L: Our preview dedupe runs on connection_fingerprint (includes egress_ip). If egress_ip flips we can double-count in preview.
Maya C: Final ledger dedupe uses req_id later. Some SDKs don't set X-Request-Id so we lose that anchor.
CS Ops: Customer flagged ticket, holding while we investigate.
billing-bot: alert: preview_delta_pct{tenant="neo-hq"} = 32.7
Owen L: Short-term: pause further rotations and pin egress for that pool for 30m.
Maya C: Mid-term: change preview dedupe order -> prefer X-Request-Id if present, else compute payload_hash(model+first64tokens+tenant) only when req_id absent. Gate behind feature flag.
Owen L: Also add console note on "Preview vs Final" with runbook link and last egress change to reduce support churn.
Maya C: I'll open INC-4302 and PR-5580. Plan: canary shadow dedupe in prod for 1h, enable 5% tenants after telemetry looks good.
CS Ops: Notifying account team and prepping communication.
Maya C: TL;DR pin now, deploy shadow dedupe, console blurb, retro after incident.
